title: When an Elasticsearch data source is configured with a time-based index pattern, Grafana generated one index name for…
description: Grafana versions configured with an Elasticsearch data source using a time-based index pattern can generate excessive index names for queries with large time ranges. This behavior can cause the server to allocate excessive memory, potentially leading to termination of the Grafana server process. The issue affects users with query permissions, including those with only Viewer role in default configurations. Data sources using static index names are not affected.
